name: ripple
description: Ripple — pre-merge blast radius and accountability gate for Bitbucket Cloud (two Forge apps: Gate + Brain)

scripts.typecheck: npm run build && tsc -p packages/contracts/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p apps/gate && tsc -p apps/brain && tsc -p tests && svelte-check --tsconfig ./apps/gate/src/frontend/tsconfig.json --fail-on-warnings --output machine
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run check:no-any && npm run check:scopes && npm run bundle
scripts.bundle: node scripts/build-app.mjs gate && node scripts/build-app.mjs brain
